about.title: The Art of Tailoring
about.p1: Located in the heart of Urban Estate Phase 1 Market, Patiala, Purba Fashion Makers has been defining bespoke elegance.
about.p2: We don't just stitch clothes; we craft confidence. Our specialization in Pathani kurtas and Nehru jackets comes from years of dedication to understanding the perfect fit, the right fabric, and the subtle details that make a garment truly yours.
about.p3: Whether you have a wedding tomorrow or a festival next week, our fast deadline accommodation ensures you never have to compromise on looking your absolute best. We operate with a WhatsApp-first approach, making ordering and fittings seamless for our clients.

cta.title: Ready for your perfect fit?
cta.subtitle: Skip the wait. Message us directly on WhatsApp to discuss fabrics, measurements, and deadlines.
cta.note: We accommodate fast deadlines for urgent events.

process.title: How It Works
process.step1Desc: Message us on WhatsApp. We discuss your requirements, fabric choices, and deadline.
process.step2Desc: Visit our Patiala shop for precise measurements or share a perfectly fitting reference garment.
process.step3Desc: Our master tailors cut and stitch your garment with absolute precision.
process.step4Desc: Final trial and adjustments if needed, delivered exactly when promised.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, we specialize in fast deadlines. Message us on WhatsApp with your exact requirement and date, and we'll confirm immediately.
faq.q2: Can I order completely via WhatsApp?
faq.a2: Absolutely. Many of our regular clients just send us fabric choices and reference images on WhatsApp. We have their measurements on file.
faq.q3: Do you provide fabrics or should I bring my own?
faq.a3: Both! We have a curated selection of premium fabrics for kurtas and jackets, but we are equally happy to stitch fabric you bring to us.
faq.a4: Our signature items are Pathani kurtas and Nehru jackets. We pride ourselves on the structure, fit, and finishing of these specific garments.
